blocks.title: ZEVM factory
blocks.text: Embeddable Zig Ethereum node: execution on guillotine-mini, primitives from Voltaire, JSON-RPC, a beacon light client, and C and Node-API bindings. Every Zig target keys on the pinned sibling sources, so `smthrs ci //...` replays unchanged checks locally and from the Smithers remote cache.
